question: How do I set up automated documentation updates when a new release is created in my feature repository?
ground_truth: To set up automated documentation updates, you need to configure two GitHub Actions workflows. First, add a notify-docs-repo.yml workflow to your feature repository that triggers on release creation and sends a notification to your documentation repository using the GitHub API. Second, add an auto-merge-on-release.yml workflow to your documentation repository that listens for the notification and automatically merges approved PRs with matching dependency labels when the corresponding feature is released.
